head.text: First run: the stack starts, and when it does not · 2026-09-18 · decided

decided.text: DECIDED (George, 2026-09-18): B, the chain. The stopped node wears --term-red. The foot line is gone. The Porch mark is back on the card, with its look left and right. The title reads "NeuraMesh is starting up…". The A (rows) and B7 (stage line) alternates of version 2 retired. This version is the visual contract the build follows: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/views/LocalStackGate.tsx, tokens.css .lsg*, evidence in docs/design/first-run-stack-2026-09/evidence.

fail.text:
THE FAILURE CARD has three parts: the CAUSE in plain words, the container's own last line in a mono well, the REMEDY. COPY DETAILS puts the three on the clipboard. An error with no diagnosis (Colima did not start.) keeps the two-line card.
The bug on George's Mac: a first start failed on a port clash (the dev stack holds 127.0.0.1:58081), Docker Desktop then dropped the container's network, and every later start "succeeded" with no network. Try again could never fix it, because compose keeps a container whose config did not change. The driver now checks both ports first (B4), marks a container with no network for recreation, ends a crash loop in seconds with the container's last line (B2, B3), and recreates the failed container on Try again.
